new_results.statement: For every invertible symmetric physical 2x2 pair B, D=|det B|, and independent cap-one X,Y with arbitrary translations, p_{(X+a,Y+b)^T B(X+a,Y+b)}(t) <= (2+2pi)D^(-1/3)|t|^(-1/3) for a.e. t!=0; if B is indefinite, constant 6 suffices.
If sup_z P(|R-z|<rho)<=min(1,H sqrt(rho)), then sup_z E|R-z|^(-1/3)<=3H^(2/3).

For a physical pair S with invertible A[S,S] and localized overlap-two mass J2(S)>0, ||p_Q||inf<=129.924435862525374 J2(S)^(-1/6), with 94.1119371673922894 in the indefinite case; determinant and condition number cancel.
In the same all-signature branch, int |t|^(-1/2)|phi_Q(t)|^2 dt <=114.28660859120921 J2(S)^(-1/12), derived posteriorly from the one-copy density bound and the whole-output independent-copy identity.

unresolved_implication: Aggregate overlap-two exterior mass may be spread over singular physical pairs; the spectral hypothesis does not yet force one invertible pair with dimension-free J2. Overlap-one and principal-overlap sectors also remain globally unpaid.

continuity: The new pair-plus-residual mixture proves absolute continuity and an essential L-infinity bound in its scope; continuity is not proved by this compiler.
